queries_run: Visa stablecoin threat card networks substitute technology 2026
pay-by-bank account-to-account payments threat to Visa Mastercard 2026

findings.claim: Visa 10-K 自述：穩定幣在法規明朗後可運作全球 24/7、支援跨境，B2B 區塊鏈/穩定幣支付為 CMS（如 Visa Direct）的替代競爭來源；ACH、RTP、電匯亦為替代方案。
findings.excerpt: We compete with alternative solutions to our CMS (e.g., Visa Direct) such as ACH, RTP and wires.

findings.claim: Visa 10-K 風險因子：2025 年 7 月美國 GENIUS Act 建立穩定幣監管框架，穩定幣可能顛覆現有支付網路，尤其跨境與 B2B。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: With more regulatory certainty and permissive or favorable regulations, stablecoins could potentially disrupt existing payment networks, including in cross-border and B2B transactions.

findings.claim: Visa 10-K 指出 GenAI/agentic commerce 對 Visa 既是創新機會，也帶來競爭與新的資安風險。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: GenAI and agentic commerce solutions have emerged as an opportunity for Visa, its clients, suppliers, sellers and partners to innovate more quickly and better serve consumers.

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋摘要（Third Bridge 2026 初、American Banker）提到穩定幣被視為長期威脅、歐洲 Wero 等 A2A 上線，Mastercard 買 BVNK；但為二手摘要無可逐字原文，僅放 clues。

clues.claim: 分析師觀點：穩定幣被廣泛視為 Visa/Mastercard 最大長期威脅，但缺乏消費者保護與詐欺管理層，短期難全面取代。
clues.source: Third Bridge perspectives: Disruption or distraction? Why stablecoins haven't shaken the card networks

clues.claim: A2A/open banking 對卡量構成雙刃劍；Visa 購入 Tink（$2.15 billion）以布局非卡支付。
clues.source: American Banker: How Visa and Mastercard are bolstering non-card payments
